name: Sentinel-2 Patch-wise LULC Benchmark
description: In this paper, patch-wise land cover and land use (LCLU) classification was performed using the state-of-art ResNet 50 and Inception-ResNet-V2 architecture trained with Stochastic Gradient Descent(SGD) and Nadam optimizers. A new dataset was generated for the classification task using Sentinel-2 images having different patch sizes. The image patches were labeled using CORINE Land Cover (CLC) 2018 map. The dataset has 1961 image patches and it was divided into 1397 training and 564 testing patches during the experiment. Our dataset contains samples labeled with 7 CLC Level-2 classes. While the best training accuracy of 98.0% was obtained by Inception-ResNet-V2 trained with Nadam. The best testing accuracy of 93.0% was achieved with Inception-ResNet-V2 by using SGD optimizer.
reputation: A niche remote-sensing benchmark used in land-cover/land-use classification research, but not widely adopted outside the Sentinel-2 LULC subcommunity.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; relatively small patch-wise dataset with potential class imbalance and spatial autocorrelation; results depend on patch size and preprocessing choices.
